## Why This Is Asked

Real-time PII redaction is critical for compliance and privacy in customer chat systems across domains and languages. This question tests ability to combine simple regex with a learnable component and reason about latency and privacy.

## Key Concepts

- PII patterns, regex, obfuscated formats
- Lightweight ML with bilingual data
- Latency and on-device inference
- Data privacy and logging controls

## Code Example

```javascript
// PII redaction detector (regex-based)
function redactPII(text){
  const email = /[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/gi;
  const phone = /(\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?(\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?)?(\d{3})[-.\s]?(\d{4})/g;
  return text
    .replace(email, '[REDACTED_EMAIL]')
    .replace(phone, '[REDACTED_PHONE]');
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you reduce false positives with mixed languages or code-switching?
- How to measure latency and privacy impact in production?

## Why This Is Asked

This question evaluates understanding of multi-tenant privacy-aware NLP systems, practical federation strategies, and enterprise governance. It assesses whether candidates can balance privacy requirements—such as differential privacy and regulatory compliance—with production concerns including latency, drift detection, and safe model rollout.

## Key Concepts

- **Privacy preservation**: DP-SGD training, logical data isolation, entity redaction
- **Multi-tenant architecture**: tenant-specific adapter layers with a shared backbone, resource allocation controls
